005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import org.wpilib.annotation.NoDiscard;
010
011/**
012 * A stage in a command builder where requirements and main command execution logic have been set.
013 * No more changes to requirements or command implementation may happen after this point. This is
014 * the final step in command creation
015 */
016@NoDiscard
017public interface NeedsNameBuilderStage {
018  /**
019   * Optionally sets a callback to execute when the command is canceled. The callback will not run
020   * if the command was canceled after being scheduled but before starting to run, and will not run
021   * if the command completes naturally or from encountering an unhandled exception.
022   *
023   * @param onCancel The function to execute when the command is canceled while running. May be
024   *     null.
025   * @return This builder object, for chaining
026   */
027  NeedsNameBuilderStage whenCanceled(Runnable onCancel);
028
029  /**
030   * Sets the priority level of the command.
031   *
032   * @param priority The desired priority level.
033   * @return This builder object, for chaining.
034   */
035  NeedsNameBuilderStage withPriority(int priority);
036
037  /**
038   * Optionally sets an end condition for the command. If the end condition returns {@code true}
039   * before the command body set in {@link NeedsExecutionBuilderStage#executing(Consumer)} would
040   * exit, the command will be canceled by the scheduler.
041   *
042   * @param endCondition An optional end condition for the command. May be null.
043   * @return This builder object, for chaining.
044   */
045  NeedsNameBuilderStage until(BooleanSupplier endCondition);
046
047  /**
048   * Creates the command based on the options set during previous builder stages. The builders will
049   * no longer be usable after calling this method.
050   *
051   * @param name The name of the command
052   * @return The built command.
053   * @throws NullPointerException If {@code name} is null.
054   */
055  Command named(String name);
056}
